Under the general direction of the Director of Professional Programs and Campus Partnerships, the Professional Programs Analyst serves as a technical and analytical resource for the Professional Programs and Partnerships team. Working across the full program lifecycle, the analyst examines performance, identifies opportunities and risks, and helps teams move from evidence to action. The role also supports instructor services and advances new program development through research, planning, and process improvement.
30% - Program Lifecycle Analysis and Performance

The analyst serves as a trusted analytical and project resource for the Professional Programs and Partnership team. In partnership with functional specialists, the position develops measures of program health, evaluates recruitment and service workflows, and builds the reports and tools that make performance visible. The analyst also independently leads defined projects that cross team boundaries, bringing structure to ambiguous questions, coordinating implementation and assessing results. Deliverables may include dashboards, program-health reports, market scans, business cases, executive summaries, project plans, and process documentation.
30% - Instructor Services Team Support
